title: Desktop files
whyItMatters: Desktop files are usually active work in progress and often include documents the owner would not want a stranger to see.
source: Apple Support, add Desktop and Documents to iCloud Drive: https://support.apple.com/en-us/109344
notes: Desktop is TCC-protected on modern macOS; without Full Disk Access the scan records a permission skip. If iCloud sync is on, files may be online-only placeholders.
